baseline.label: Status quo (voluntary commitments)
baseline.name: baseline
baseline.note: No new obligation. Existing consumer and product law only, with the regulator's present capacity. Every other policy is measured against this path, pair by pair.

liability_with_safe_harbour.label: Liability with a safe harbour
liability_with_safe_harbour.name: liability_with_safe_harbour
liability_with_safe_harbour.note: Strict liability, but a firm that meets the evaluation and safety spend standard is shielded from most of it. Compliance becomes the cheaper choice.

mandatory_third_party_evals.label: Mandatory third party evaluation
mandatory_third_party_evals.name: mandatory_third_party_evals
mandatory_third_party_evals.note: Independent pre deployment evaluation above a threshold, with a short approval delay. Catches a share of unsafe releases before they ship.

strict_liability.label: Strict liability
strict_liability.name: strict_liability
strict_liability.note: Firms pay for the harm their systems cause, insured by mandate. No ex ante obligation: the price of an incident does the work, and the firms choose their own safety spend.

question: Compare strict liability with liability under a safe harbour and mandatory third party evaluations over the next five years; the technology sector's net loss must stay below $300bn and the probability of a catastrophic incident must fall by at least a quarter.

decision_gap.note: headline score: the value weighted price reaction against the baseline over the first six months plus a tenth of the early news tone difference; social order: expected net social value over the horizon
